compute_perplexity: compute perplexity scores for a list of text snippets using a causal language model
evaluate_text_similarity: evaluate how similar a dataset is to the distribution of text a model was trained on
run_perplexity_batch: run perplexity computation on text data in configurable batch sizes with optional GPU acceleration
test_model_training_fit: test how well a dataset matches a model's training distribution via perplexity scoring
review_perplexity_scores: review individual and mean perplexity scores returned for each input text snippet
